bull_bear.body:
- Key strengths slide states "CONCRETE STEPS FOR DEBT REDUCTION UNDERWAY".
- Content investment is framed as risk-managed: "Additional VFX & animation services revenues create a natural hedge for content investments", with production limited to "Selective strategic co-productions with top tier studios and film makers".
- Forward visibility for funding growth is framed as "c.$1bn Order book & visible pipeline for FY27 and beyond", split between "Contracted & Confirmed" and "Highly Visible Pipeline", plus "Additional addressable market revenue opportunities of $270 mn+".
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Creative vertical is positioned as the "World's No. 1 independent VFX and animation services provider", doing "Premium Film and Episodic Visual Effects" with "Key creative partnerships with the world's biggest studios and directors".
- DNEG credentials cited as "25 YEARS OF CLIENT RELATIONSHIPS", "80+ Industry leading VFX Supervisors", and marquee titles including Dune: Part One and Two, Tenet, Interstellar, Inception, Harry Potter, The Lord of the Rings, Dunkirk, The Last of Us and Chernobyl.
- BRAHMA AI is described as "THE LEADING AI-NATIVE ENTERPRISE CONTENT PLATFORM" offering "Highest Fidelity Output Combined with Enterprise-grade Trust Infrastructure".
- Revenue base described as "c.90% Revenue from recurring customers" and "c.94% Revenue ex-India"; key strengths slide lists "HIGHLY RECURRING AND VISIBLE REVENUE BASE" and "DIVERSIFIED REVENUE STREAMS CONTRIBUTING TO GROWTH".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Litigation] The deck reports "Exceptional items of INR 66cr was primarily on account of the settlement in relation to the NCLT proceedings"; the accompanying footnote states the exceptional item "Includes a) INR 71cr towards NCLT proceedings related settlement and b) INR 6cr net gain in relation to JV/subsidiary" - both figures are quoted as printed.
- [Ramayana distribution] "Sony Pictures comes onboard for global theatrical distribution (excluding India)", described as the "First Indian film to secure a place on the Hollywood theatrical landscape at this scale" with an "Estimated 50,000+ screens across 100+ theatrical markets worldwide"; Dharma Productions joins as India (ex-South) distribution partner and T-Series leads Music & Audio across India, with "Other distribution and digital rights under negotiations".
- [Marketing traction] Ramayana had the "largest-ever global showcase for an Indian film at San Diego Comic-Con 2026" including a Hall H presentation that "drew a crowd of 5,000+", and a trailer with "1BN+ views within the first 7 days".
- [IP rights precedent] BRAHMA AI "delivered the digital likeness of Japanese singer and actress Hibari Misora", built "using ATMAN models trained on historical footage and audio, broadcast on a BS Nippon TV special in January 2026 with full estate approval" - presented as proof it "can operate at national broadcast standard in one of the world's most rights sensitive cultural markets".
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Prime Focus Limited as an integrated platform across three verticals - Creative (DNEG, described as the world's No. 1 independent VFX and animation services provider), AI/Technology (BRAHMA AI enterprise content platform) and Production (Prime Focus Studios co-productions) - with a global footprint whose largely India-based workforce is presented as a structural cost advantage.
